endpoints.title: Endpoints
endpoints.subtitle: Entry points that receive webhooks, authenticate them and forward them to your application.
endpoints.emptyBody: An endpoint gives you a unique URL to paste into Stripe, GitHub or any provider. HookShield checks each webhook and delivers it to your app with retries.

auth.tokenHint: Senders include a secret token in a header. Simple and works with any provider.
auth.hmacHint: Verifies an HMAC-SHA256 signature of the raw body (GitHub, Shopify…). Timestamped schemes such as Stripe's are not supported: use a token.
auth.ipHint: Accepts webhooks only from the addresses you list.
auth.headerHint: Header the sender puts the token in.
auth.hmacSecretHint: Paste the provider's webhook secret (e.g. GitHub's). Leave empty to generate one.

reveal.once: Copy it now: for your security it is shown only once and cannot be recovered. You can rotate it later.
reveal.acknowledge: I have copied it to a safe place

create.title: New endpoint
create.basicsHint: Where webhooks go after HookShield checks them.
create.name: Name
create.targetHint: Your application's URL. HookShield delivers each webhook here with retries.
create.securityHint: How HookShield recognizes genuine webhooks. Requests that fail the check are rejected.
create.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, - and _. It cannot change later. Leave empty for a random one.

retry.title: Retry policy
retry.subtitle: What happens when your application is down or answers with an error.
retry.exponentialHint: Each wait is longer than the last. Recommended.
retry.maxDelayHint: No wait is ever longer than this.
retry.customRepeat: The last delay repeats until the maximum number of retries.
retry.noRetries: No retries: a failed delivery is final.
retry.jitter: Delays vary ±10% so retries do not all hit your app at once, and a longer Retry-After from your app is honoured.

statusHint.paused: Answers 503 so senders keep and retry their webhooks; nothing is lost.
statusHint.debug: Works like active, flagged for troubleshooting.

detail.rotateBody: The current value stops working immediately. Update every sender with the new one.
detail.changeAuthHint: Switching modes discards the previous credentials; a new token is shown once.
detail.deliveryHint: Headers added to every delivery, retries and the dead-letter queue.
detail.outboundHint: Sent to your application with every webhook. Values can use {ref}, resolved at delivery time and never stored with payloads.
detail.missingSecrets: Missing secrets: {names}. Deliveries will fail until you <link>create them</link>.
detail.dlqHint: Keep webhooks that exhausted every retry for auditing and replay.
detail.rulesCount: {n, plural, one {# rule changes} other {# rules change}} each webhook before delivery.
detail.noRules: Webhooks are forwarded exactly as received.
detail.alertRuleHint: Alerts go to your alert channels once per incident.
detail.channelsHint: Channels for all endpoints plus the ones only for this one.
detail.noChannels: No channel yet: failures are only visible in the logs.
detail.receiveHint: Paste this URL in your provider's webhook settings.
detail.noLogsBody: Send a test event or point your provider at the ingest URL.
detail.deleteBody: Its URL stops accepting webhooks and its logs and alert channels are deleted. This cannot be undone.

logs.title: Logs & Debugger
logs.subtitle: Every webhook received, what HookShield did with it and what your application answered.
logs.emptyBody: They appear here in real time as soon as an endpoint receives one.
logs.emptyFilteredBody: Try another period, status or search.

filters.search: Search by request ID or event type

live.fresh: {n, plural, one {# new webhook} other {# new webhooks}} — show

debugger.title: Request
debugger.notTransformedBody: The endpoint had no transform rules for this webhook.
debugger.noResponse: No HTTP response: the destination could not be reached.
debugger.noAttemptsBody: The first attempt starts as soon as a worker picks the webhook up.
debugger.editReplayHint: The replay is a new webhook that goes through the endpoint's current rules, headers and retry policy.
debugger.binaryNoEdit: Binary bodies cannot be edited; Replay resends them unchanged.

transform.title: Payload transformer
transform.subtitle: Change webhooks before they reach your application: rename keys, strip fields, add values and headers. The preview runs the same code as the gateway.
transform.noEndpointsBody: Rules belong to an endpoint. Create one first.
transform.saved: Rules saved. New webhooks use them right away.
transform.noLatest: This endpoint has not received webhooks yet
transform.bodyNotJson: Not a JSON object: body rules will be skipped, header rules still apply.
transform.pipelineHint: Rules run top to bottom; each sees the result of the previous one.
transform.rulesJsonHint: Same format as the API (docs/TRANSFORM.md). Leave empty to remove every rule.
transform.invalidRulesJson: The rules document is not valid JSON
transform.secretsNote: Authentication headers with secrets are set in the endpoint's <link>outbound headers</link>, so secrets never touch stored payloads.
transform.fixRulesBody: The preview runs as soon as every rule is valid.

warnings.notJson: The body is not a JSON object: body rules were skipped.
warnings.other: A rule had no effect on this sample.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.subtitle: Encrypted values you reference in outbound headers, such as your destination's API key. Values can never be read back.
secrets.emptyBody: Store credentials here and use them as {ref} in an endpoint's outbound headers.
secrets.name: Name
secrets.nameRule: Uppercase letters, numbers and _, starting with a letter (max. 64).
secrets.valueHint: Encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Up to 8 KiB, on one line.
secrets.replaced: Value replaced. New deliveries use it right away.
secrets.deleteBody: Deliveries of endpoints that reference it will fail until you create it again.
secrets.note: Secrets are injected only at delivery time and never stored with payloads or shown in logs.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.subtitle: Keys for scripts, CI and infrastructure as code. Each key has a scope; only the dashboard can create keys.
apiKeys.emptyBody: Create a key to read logs, replay webhooks or manage endpoints from your own tools.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.once: Copy the key now. For your security it is shown only once and masked when you close this window.
apiKeys.copiedHint: Store it in your secret manager.
apiKeys.revokeBody: Requests with this key are refused immediately. This cannot be undone.
apiKeys.usageHint: Send it as a Bearer token. Requests with a key carry no cookie, so they need no Origin header.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.subtitle: Where HookShield warns you when deliveries keep failing. Each incident alerts once, in your account's language.
alerts.emptyBody: Add an email, Slack, Telegram or webhook channel so you hear about failures before your users do.

typeHints.slack: An incoming webhook of your workspace.
typeHints.webhook: A JSON POST to your own system.
typeHints.telegram: A bot message to a chat or channel.

fields.emailHint: Leave empty to use your account email.
fields.urlHint: Receives a JSON body with the endpoint, the failure and a link to the log.

alerts.deleteBody: Alerts stop going to this destination.
alerts.note: Destinations are stored encrypted and shown masked. The failure threshold is set per endpoint.

settings.title: Account settings
settings.subtitle: Your profile, preferences, password and plan.
settings.name: Name
settings.preferencesHint: Saved on your account and used on every device.
settings.languageHint: Emails and alerts use this language too.
settings.passwordHint: Changing it signs out your other sessions.
settings.noPassword: You sign in with Google. To also use a password, <link>request a password link</link>.
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
settings.usage: {count, plural, one {# webhook} other {# webhooks}} in the last 30 days
settings.billingSoon: Self-hosted HookShield has no plan limits.

sandbox.title: Sandbox
sandbox.subtitle: Send test events through the real pipeline and copy ready-to-run snippets for your provider or your own code.
sandbox.noEndpoints: Create an endpoint to start testing
sandbox.noEndpointsBody: Test events go through an endpoint's rules, headers and retries, exactly like real webhooks.
sandbox.composeHint: Skips the inbound authentication (you are signed in); everything else is the real thing.
sandbox.notJson: Not JSON: sent as plain text.
sandbox.paused: This endpoint is paused. Resume it to send events.
sandbox.fromCodeHint: The same request, from anywhere. A 202 means HookShield accepted it.
sandbox.authToken: Replace {placeholder} with the endpoint token (header {header}). Lost it? Rotate it in the endpoint's security tab.
sandbox.authHmac: Sign the raw body with HMAC-SHA256 using the endpoint's signing secret.
sandbox.authIp: Send from an address in the endpoint's allow-list.
sandbox.apiReferenceHint: OpenAPI 3.1 document of the control-plane API. Import it in Postman or Insomnia.
sandbox.needKey: Calling the API from scripts? Create an API key →

billing.title: Plans & billing
billing.subtitle: Your plan, this month's usage and invoices. Payments are processed by Paddle, our merchant of record.
billing.unavailable: Billing is not available on this server
billing.unavailableBody: Self-hosted HookShield has no plans or limits.
billing.stillProcessing: Payment received, but it is still being processed. Your plan will update shortly; refresh this page in a minute.
billing.freeNote: Free forever. Upgrade when you need more requests, retries or retention.
billing.endsOn: Cancelled: {plan} stays active until {date}, then you return to the free plan.
billing.pastDue: The last payment failed. Update your payment method to keep the plan.
billing.inactive: The subscription is not active: free plan limits apply.

usage.title: Requests this month
usage.blocked: Quota reached: new webhooks are refused (429) until the month resets or you upgrade.
usage.overage: Above the included quota: extra requests are billed as overage.
usage.nearBlocked: Over 80% of the quota: upgrade to avoid refused webhooks.

billing.downgradeHint: To return to the free plan, cancel in “Manage billing”.

features.retention: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} of log retention
features.hardLimit: Webhooks above the quota are refused

billing.note: Prices in USD, taxes calculated at checkout. Usage resets on the 1st of each month (UTC), also on yearly plans; overage is billed with the next invoice (on yearly plans, when each month ends).
billing.switchBody: The change applies now. The price difference is prorated on your next invoice.
billing.switchIntervalBody: The change applies now and a new billing period starts today: you are charged the new price minus the unused part of the current period. Quotas stay monthly.
